description.value: Heritage Restaurant & Bar is the Mount Pleasant flagship of the Heritage Asian Eatery group, offering a contemporary sit-down take on classic Chinese cuisine — think handcrafted dumplings, Peking duck, and Chinese BBQ alongside handcrafted cocktails, beer, and wine. The space is described as a contemporary setting where casual meals and celebrations share the same menu. Reservations are available and recommended, as the Pender Street sister location is walk-in only.
